{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Tibanna}}
[[File:Carbo_cut_away.jpg|right|thumb|250px|A cutaway shows the inner workings of a [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] block used for transporting tibanna gas.]]
{{Quote|Yeah, a tibanna gas mine. Lando conned somebody out of it.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Empire">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Tibanna''' was a rare form of matter found in both gas and liquid form. In its natural state as a gas, tibanna composed the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]] of several [[Planet/Legends|planets]], most notably that of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], where it was processed at [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], and the planets [[Genarius]], [[Kaer]], [[Kril'Dor/Legends|Kril'Dor]], [[Ord Ibanna]], [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]], [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]], [[Vandin]] and [[Yorn Skot]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Above us you can see the ''beldons'', who excrete ''tibanna gas'' after consumin' and processin' ''nutrients'' they find in the air.''"<br />"''Yes, tibanna is actually a ''waste product''.|[[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Fivvle]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="In the Air">{{TCWComicCite|6.14|In the Air}}</ref>}}
Tibanna gas was excreted by [[Beldon/Legends|beldons]], huge gas-filled creatures. The gas was a byproduct of the vapors consumed by beldons. Tibanna was extracted from [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] as atmospheric gases rose on updrafts through [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City's]] unipod. The gas was then processed and packed in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] for transport off-planet.

Tibanna gas produced four times its normal energy output when cohesive light passed through it. Thus, spin-sealed (compacted at the atomic level) tibanna was used as a conducting agent in [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and other energy weapons, producing greater energy yields and thus greater amounts of damage. Most personal weapons could not tolerate this power boost, but ship-mounted blasters benefited greatly from the use of tibanna gas. Exceptions to this were the [[DC-15|DC series rifles]] of [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], which used tibanna gas to produce powerful ionized bolts that were damaging to both organics and droids, something that was crucial to winning the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Tibanna was also used to make a useful [[DC-19 "Stealth" carbine|variant]] of the DC series ionized bolt, which made the weapons' energy output imperceptible to the naked eye.

[[Gas giant/Legends|Gas giants]] with significant amounts of tibanna were known to possess a layer called [[tibanisphere]].

==Uses==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Tibanna gas'' is a valuable commodity as a starship ''hyperdrive coolant''&hellip; so whoever ''controls'' the flow of tibanna gas can ''direct the war''. If we ''block'' the Republic's tibanna supplies it will ''cripple'' their forces and their capacity for ''interplanetary travel''.|[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], to [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]|<ref name="In the Air" />}}
[[File:JKAlevelshot_t2_wedge.png|thumb|230px|[[Tibanna gas platform|Tibanna mining platforms]] on Kril'Dor]]
Tibanna gas was primarily used as a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] [[Coolant/Legends|coolant]]. [[Spin-sealed]] tibanna could be used as a [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] for energy weapons such as [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]; the process compressed the molecules of [[Gas/Legends|gas]], storing a tremendous amount of energy. Spin-sealed tibanna occurred naturally in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Tibanna gas was also used as a heating agent in the preparation of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] such as the [[grasser]] [[Steak/Legends|steak]].<ref name="SW8">[[Star Wars (1998) 8|''Star Wars'' (1998) 8]]</ref>

TibannaX was a special isotope of tibanna gas used in [[StealthX]]s. Its ion emissions cooled in several milliseconds, making the StealthX hard to track.

Supercooled tibanna gas was used in [[baffled drive]]s to help prevent detection.<ref name="SAV">''[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|Scum and Villany]]''</ref>

==History==
During the Clone Wars, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] used highly flammable liquid tibanna to heat their [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] on the [[Rishi moon]]. However, when [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|attacked]] the base, trooper [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]] used the liquid tibanna to destroy the outpost.<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>

At some point during the mid-[[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the crime lord [[Tyber Zann]] [[Ground Battle on Bespin|stole]] a large quantity of tibanna from Bespin, pinning the theft on Prince [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], and made a large amount of money from selling it on the black market.<ref name="FOC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

[[File:Bespin_TEA.jpg|thumb|250px|Bespin, a source of tibanna]]
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Battle above Taloraan|attacked]] a large supply of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] gas, which was being mined from the gas giant [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]].<ref name="RSI">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref> The gas was a vital commodity for the Alliance prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and Rogue Squadron led an aerial [[Raid on Bespin|assault]] on Cloud City, their primary objective being to secure as many tibanna gas platforms orbiting the city as possible.<ref name="RSII">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref>

During the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] rigged a tibanna gas cartridge to explode, freeing him from a trap in the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]] base.

In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], [[Kril'Dor/Legends|Kril'Dor]] was the site of a New Republic [[Mission to Kril'Dor|mission]] to liberate a tibanna gas mining platform from the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. [[Jaden Korr]] and Wedge Antilles participated in the successful mission.<ref name="JK:JA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>

By the time of the [[Dark Nest Crisis]], tibanna gas was being stolen by [[Joiner]]s for use in the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] military buildup. TibannaX was also an important resource in the use of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-exclusive StealthX fighters. [[Xtib]], the company that produced TibannaX, was later purchased by [[Bornaryn Trading]].
